# Sign Wave: file and folder reference

Snapshot: 3 November 2026. Read [START-HERE.md](START-HERE.md) for the presentation script and [PROJECT-REVIEW.md](PROJECT-REVIEW.md) for the actual data flows and limitations.

This catalogue lists **5,017 project files in 795 directories**. It scanned 3,961 UTF-8 text files to extract roles, symbols and test descriptions. The detailed architectural review focuses on executable source/configuration. Binary model weights, images and videos are inventoried by role/size rather than interpreted as source code. Role descriptions and symbol extraction are navigation aids, not proof that a feature is complete or a test passed.

Third-party packages, Git internals and root generated caches/build outputs are excluded from per-file review. Native embedded web copies and functions/lib are included and identified as generated replicas that can lag current source. Review documents themselves are excluded from this snapshot. The exclusions are listed below. Existing local environment configuration values are not reproduced.

## Source-reading conventions

- `.ts` / `.js`: implementation, data definitions, model inference or tooling. Listed classes/methods are extracted from the file.
- `.html`: screen structure, bindings and events. It does not independently implement an algorithm.
- `.scss` / `.css`: layout, colors, spacing and animation presentation.
- `.spec.ts`: tests and fixtures. Case titles are sampled, not reported as passed.
- `model.json`: pretrained network topology and references to weight shards. `.bin` / `.tflite`: binary numerical model data.
- Native store locales/screenshots: app-store presentation material, not sign-training samples.

## Excluded third-party/generated directories

- `.angular`
- `.git`
- `dist`
- `node_modules`
- `android/.gradle`
- `docs/node_modules`
- `docs/review`
- `docs/.vitepress/dist`
- `functions/node_modules`

## Reading boundaries

No camera inference, remote translation success, native build success or model accuracy is established by this catalogue. Read the main review for sample-data paths, missing connections, rule shadowing and offline behavior. The inventory JSON provides the same paths/roles in a machine-readable form.
